description: Works out one of What Property's free UK property investment calculators (deals by strategy, mortgages, bridging, refinancing, purchase tax, buying costs, returns, works, offers, developments) on the figures given, and draws it where the client shows MCP Apps so the person can change the figures. Free; nothing is saved or looked up. Inputs not sent start from a typical example, and the reply lists which were assumed. Money is in whole pounds and rates in percentages (5.5 for 5.5%). The buy-to-let, hmo, brrr, flip and serviced-accommodation calculators score the figures out of 100 as a full check would.

calculator.description: Which calculator to run. buy-to-let: Cash flow, yield, cash return and the lenders' stress test, with a score. hmo: Room income, bills, management and setup for a house let by the room. brrr: Buy, refurbish, refinance, rent: the money left in after the refinance. flip: Profit and margin on a buy, refurbish and sell, with every cost counted. serviced-accommodation: Bookings from a nightly rate and occupancy, less fees, cleaning and bills. rent-to-rent: Profit on a house you rent and let by the room, and its break-even. rental-yield: Gross and net yield, and the rent each yield needs at a price. roi: The return on your cash over the years: cash flow and growth together. capital-growth: What a property is worth in future years, and what that does to your equity. buy-to-let-mortgage: Monthly payments, and how much the rent lets you borrow on the stress test. bridging-loan: Interest, fees, the cash that reaches you and what you repay at the end. refinance: The cash a remortgage releases at a new value, capped by what the rent supports. stamp-duty: Purchase tax on a second home or buy-to-let in each UK nation, band by band. buying-costs: The cash a purchase takes: deposit, purchase tax, legal, survey and works. offer: The most to pay for a refurb project, working back from the profit you want. below-market-value: The discount on a price against the market value, and the offer for a target. refurb-cost: Works priced item by item for a home's size and condition. price-per-square-foot: A price as pounds a square foot and a square metre, against the area's rate. development: Profit on cost and on sale value, and the most to pay for the site.

inputs.description:
The calculator's inputs by key; any not known can be left out.
Shared inputs: price (purchase price, £); rentPcm (monthly rent, £ a month); works (works, £); depositPct (deposit, %); ratePct (mortgage rate, % interest only); buyer (additional|ltd); management (self|agent); nation (england|wales|scotland|northern_ireland); bedrooms (letting rooms, number); valueAfterWorks (value after works, £); funding (bridging|cash).
buy-to-let: price, rentPcm, works, depositPct, ratePct, buyer, management, nation.
hmo: price, bedrooms, roomRentPcm (rent a room, £ a month), works, setup (full|furniture), depositPct, ratePct, buyer, nation.
brrr: price, works, valueAfterWorks, rentPcm, ratePct, funding, buyer, management, nation.
flip: price, works, valueAfterWorks, funding, buyer, nation.
serviced-accommodation: price, bedrooms, nightly (nightly rate, £ a night), occupancyPct (nights booked, % of the year), works, depositPct, ratePct, buyer, nation.
rent-to-rent: rentPaid (rent you pay the landlord, £ a month), bedrooms, roomRentPcm (rent a room, £ a month), occupancyPct (rooms let, % of the year), billsPcm (bills, £ a month), managementPct (upkeep and management, % of the income), setup (cost to set up, £).
rental-yield: price, rentPcm, depositPct, ratePct, buyer, management, nation.
roi: price, cashIn (cash put in, £), cashflowPcm (cash flow, £ a month), growthPct (growth in value, % a year), years (held for, years), sellingPct (selling costs, %).
capital-growth: price, growthPct (growth, % a year), years (over, years), loan (mortgage, £).
buy-to-let-mortgage: price, depositPct, ratePct, termYears (term, years), rentPcm.
bridging-loan: price, ltvPct (loan to value, %), monthlyRatePct (interest, % a month), months (term, months), arrangementFeePct (arrangement fee, %), interest (retained|serviced), exitFeePct (exit fee, %), otherFees (legal and valuation, £).
refinance: valueAfterWorks, balance (loan to clear, £), ltvPct (new loan to value, %), ratePct, rentPcm, fees (refinance costs, £).
stamp-duty: price, buyer, nation.
buying-costs: price, depositPct, works, buyer, nation.
offer: valueAfterWorks, works, profitPct (profit wanted, % of the value), funding, buyer, nation.
below-market-value: marketValue (market value, £), price, targetPct (discount wanted, %).
refurb-cost: condition (cosmetic|modernise|renovation), propertyType (house|flat), bedrooms, bathrooms (bathrooms, number), floorAreaSqft (floor area, sq ft).
price-per-square-foot: price, floorAreaSqft (floor area, sq ft), localPerSqft (local price a sq ft, £).
development: gdv (sells for when built, £), sitePrice (site price, £), buildSqft (build size, sq ft), buildCostPerSqft (build cost, £ a sq ft), targetPct (profit wanted, % of the sale value), feesPct (professional fees, % of the build), contingencyPct (contingency, % of the build), financePct (finance, % of the costs), siteCostsPct (site buying costs, % of the site price), sellingPct (selling costs, % of the sale value), otherCosts (other costs, £).
